pages.title: Layers 1-9
pages.text: The first nine layers use independent paths. Layer 1 normally has only 3 beads and about 2 scramble moves. The scramble gains roughly one move every 5 total layers without sudden tier-boundary spikes.

pages.title: Layers 10-36
pages.text: The first linked path appears at layer 10. Roughly one node and one path are added every 10 layers afterward. This stage contains no locked, unstable, or hidden nodes.

pages.title: Layers 37-72
pages.text: Complexity keeps rising gradually. Locked nodes begin at layer 46, unstable nodes at layer 55, and a second locked node at layer 64. Layer 72 still reveals every target.

pages.title: Beyond Layer 72
pages.text: At total layer 73, hidden targets and limited moves begin. Hidden nodes grow about every 36 layers, unstable nodes every 24, and locks every 18. Instability also accelerates gradually to a minimum interval of 4 moves.

pages.title: Carving in Batches
pages.text: Selecting many layers makes one puzzle harder: roughly every 8 additional selected layers adds a scramble move, up to 10, while selections reaching 25 and 49 layers add one node each. Batches save time but raise single-attempt risk.
